# The GrowHub Joins Project We Care Seminar


Nov 28


Written By[Guest User](https://thegrowhub.co/news?author=696085f024d98b24c865f480)


What an awesome event held at the ArtScience Museum last night![The GrowHub Innovations Company](https://www.linkedin.com/company/thegrowhub/) spoke alongside speakers from[DBS Bank](https://www.linkedin.com/company/dbs-bank/) and ICP Hub Singapore, covering different topics in the digital space. A big "Thank You" to[Digital Assets Association (DAA)](https://www.linkedin.com/company/digitalassetsassociation/) for having us.
